name: Compact
author: Freek van Gool
description: A compact layout for small screens: rotary knobs with the value and label underneath, the knobs grouped per section in one frame, compact selects, a slim scope and a dense step grid, at roughly half the standard width and well under half the height.

appearances.name: Compact
appearances.description: Rotary knobs in grouped frames, about half the standard width.
